items.title: Woody Marks: Set for RB1 work
items.text:
With David Montgomery (groin) again ruled out for Week 9, Marks is expected to remain the Texans' clear RB1 for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bryce Young: Ready to play, ankle improving
items.text:
Panthers coach Dave Canales said Friday that Young (ankle) is ready for Sunday's game against Denver after a "great week" of practice, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Cam Skattebo: Not doing much at Friday's practice
